Natalie Fletcher is a Taimanin.

She is a user of the Metal Art and can turn her body golden, she uses katana gun blades.

Hello! I'm Natalie Fletcher from the UFS. I learned Japanese from my grandma, so I have no problem with it. I even know the Japanese phrases! Slow and steady wins the yakiniku meal! If you're strong, don't rush, and the yakiniku will be waiting for you! Enjoy! All-you-can-eat!
Natalie Fletcher



Personality
A lively and free-spirited American girl, which loves to hug people giant fan of gal culture, a bit of an airhead but full of love and not aware of the word "boundaries" in Japanese literally and figuratively. A big eater, her meals are generally American-sized. She loves Japanese games and anime, and admires the ninjas that appear in them.

She speaks Japanese, and enjoys using Japanese proverbs that she learned from her grandmother, who is of Japanese descent, but she often gets them slightly wrong. Sometimes so wrong they are complete gibberish. When greeting new people, she often hugs them, not caring about her breasts almost smooching them. She takes things easy, is skilled in combat, and is both able to fight in a team and motivate those around her.

Natalie often shouts, when she speaks saying every second Japanese word, with a very American accent, she also sings out loud, which make some of her fellow new classmates keep their distance, but she doesn't notice. She seems to be close to her grandparents, which taught her Japanese but didn't do it perfectly. She is open around sexuality and her body, though has no experience yet. Secretly, a masochist, has a tendency to spank herself when performing self-care.

She appears to sometimes quote other old anime.


Appearance
She has long blond hair and blue eyes. Wears a green battle suit.

Her casual and school clothes contain a smiley pin.

History
Background
A Taimanin born in the UFS in the year 2066.

As an American girl, she learned about Japan via ninja series and loves Gal girl culture. She was at least in part raised by her grandparents, which also taught her Japanese, though she does not speak it well. Her father was also involved in raising her and rather strict and would spank her if she caused trouble. She awoke to her Metal Art, which sometimes gets her called Golden Girl. Her swordsmanship is self-taught and still rough, but she has a talent for shooting. She also admires old-fashioned gyaru fashion, and incorporates it into her casual clothes and uniforms.

Timeline RPGX
Natalie had not been present during the foundation of the Independent Commando Unit, autumn year 2082. She would join Gosha Academy, year 2083/2088 depending on dating method, as a freshman.

Natalia arrived after the Gaiza Massacre, with the start of the new semester and is now the junior of Kotaro, Hebiko and Yukikaze, being a new first year. When she arrived, she had not many friends but beat a rampaging bear, befriending Yuri Hisui which was recently graduated. She was called into Asagi's office for a mission, shared with Kotaro, Shikanosuke, Hisui and Mibuchi Yuren

Appears during a Holographic Training Room fight against a simulated Doumeki together with Nagiriin Ryou. At first is pushed away by Ryou which struggles with her own Ninja Art, as it makes her struggle not to hurt others and comes with a personality shift. Afterward, Natalie attempts to become her friend, much to Ryou's confusion as she had been so rude to her. However, not long after this in a shared mission with her, in which the group fights against Ura, a demon god, which escaped from his "cell", both finally become close friends. Natalie is considered, together with Ryou, to be one of the most promising new students of the year.

Advertisement
Powers/Abilities
Natalie Fletcher Ultimate
Main Weapon: Gun Katana

Ninja Art: "Metal Art", "Golden Experience GOLDEN GIRL", turns her entire into a golden form of metal with enhanced durability, is able to withstand a shell piercing tank shot, her golden glow also attacks enemies. The exact limits of her art are unknown, as she has never been hit by anything strong enough to damage her.
Gun Katanas: Uses two short swords, she calls Gun Katanas, they contain a small submachine gun, as her own Ninja Art gives her defense this compensates her attack potency.
Particle Control: Taimanin are able to manipulate Taima Particles to enhance their physical strength, speed and defense. The particles are also used to counter demonic influences and strengthen damage to demons.

Media
Taimanin RPGX
Trivia
Makes a reference to "All for One. One for All", which is probably a reference to My Hero Academia. As MHA has references to America and it being an anime she possibly has watched.
The smiley pin might be a reference to another bit of American fiction, Watchmen.
There is some inconsistency around her artwork in regard to the tie which is supposed to mark the semester she called a freshman and sometimes a blue tie can be seen but in other artwork she has a red tie, which would make her a third year.
